proposals.title: Independent board chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requires the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, with phase-in discretion and waiver if no independent director is available.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Vesting for government service
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy prohibiting vesting of equity awards for senior executives who voluntarily resign to enter government service.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Clawback amendment
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, as agent for Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to amend the clawback policy to defer and forfeit a substantial portion of executive pay to satisfy monetary penalties for legal violations, with a 10-year deferral.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Gender pay equity
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, as agent for Rainer Yingling Judd
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report by October 2017 on the Company's policies and goals to reduce the gender pay gap.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: How votes are counted
proposals.proponent: Investor Voice, as agent for Mercy Rome and Equality Network Foundation
proposals.topic_summary: Asks that non-binding shareholder proposals be decided by a simple majority of votes cast FOR and AGAINST, excluding abstentions.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Special shareowner meetings
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, as agent for William Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to give holders of 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowner meeting.
